  - article:
    - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Every decision has two explicit branches (Yes / No) that lead to valid next steps. This guarantees the algorithm handles all possible cases and always reaches an output.
  - article:
    - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
    - heading "Test whether n is even." [level=3]
    - paragraph: "Rule: n mod 2 = 0 leads to Even, otherwise Odd."
    - text: Start to Read n to n mod 2 = 0 ? to Even / Odd
  - article:
    - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Leaving a branch unconnected makes the algorithm incomplete.
    - paragraph: Every decision must have both Yes and No branches leading to a valid next step or output.
